nodes.label: kind Cluster Config (llm)
nodes.rationale: Single node because the llama.cpp model PVC is ReadWriteOnce and shared by all replicas.

nodes.label: TRT-LLM Build Constraints
nodes.rationale: mpi4py 3.1.6 sdist calls new_compiler(dry_run=...), removed in setuptools 81.0.0, so the build env pins setuptools 80.10.2.

nodes.label: vLLM Overrides (humming-kernels cu12)
nodes.rationale: The +cu129 wheel METADATA requires humming-kernels[cu12] while PyPI requires [cu13]; override makes a PyPI-metadata resolve match the cu129 wheel.

nodes.label: ONNX Export Provenance (v3c file)
nodes.rationale: Each Kaggle session re-exported the ONNX file; CPU uses the v3c file so it matches the ORT CUDA speed cell. compare_onnx.py shows identical graphs and weights, metadata differs.

nodes.label: ORT Intra-op Thread Settings (default vs 4)
nodes.rationale: Default (about 8 threads) beat 4 threads by only 6 to 9%; run order and thermals are a confound.

nodes.label: YOLOv8n ONNX Runtime CPU FP32 Baseline
nodes.norm_label: yolov8n onnx runtime cpu fp32 baseline
nodes.rationale: Laptop CPU FP32 vs T4 is not like for like; side by side only. Throughput does not grow with batch on CPU (23.1, 19.8, 19.3 images/s).

nodes.label: DCGM on Kaggle (item 10)
nodes.rationale: Basic fields work; profiling fields fail with DCGMError_RequiresRoot, so the DRAM-active question stays open on Kaggle.

nodes.label: llama.cpp CPU Serving Path
nodes.rationale: Qwen2.5-1.5B Q4_K_M, --parallel 2 --threads 4; prompt cache is on by default and not limited to slots, so repeats skip prefill.

nodes.label: OpenAI-Compatible API Contract
nodes.rationale: Both engines expose the OpenAI API so the same loadgen and accuracy harness run against either.

nodes.label: TensorRT-LLM 0.14.0 Pin
nodes.rationale: Last release whose support matrix lists Turing (SM75); 0.16.0 drops 70-real kernels so no later wheel runs on a T4.

nodes.label: v3 Kaggle Notebooks (build_v3.py)
nodes.rationale: step() per unit of work with FAILED/NOT_RUN files and timeouts so a hang does not use up the session.

nodes.label: YOLOv8n Vision Path (item 11)
nodes.rationale: Ultralytics AGPL-3.0; ONNX FP32 opset 17 plus TensorRT 10.16 FP16 engines per batch size; ORT CUDA, TensorRT, Triton backends.

nodes.label: vLLM 0.31.0 on Kaggle T4
nodes.rationale: 0.31.0 still builds sm75 kernels; +cu129 wheel runs on R525+ drivers since the Kaggle driver is unknown before the session.

nodes.label: sha256-Verified Corpus Ingest (rag-ingest)
nodes.rationale: PDFs not committed; rag-ingest downloads, checks sha256 against sources.json, then rebuilds the index.

nodes.label: Machine Quieting Procedure
nodes.rationale: Kind cluster and compose stack stopped before measuring so the benchmark is not disturbed; idle state recorded.

nodes.label: --generation-config vllm flag
nodes.rationale: Without it vLLM applied Qwen2.5 generation_config.json repetition_penalty to every request, including GSM8K.

nodes.label: T4 Limits and Substitutions
nodes.rationale: No bf16/FP8/FA2 on sm75: float16 everywhere, AWQ INT4 for quantised cells, TRITON_ATTN pinned because FlashInfer is broken on SM75.

nodes.label: Public Domain Licence Basis (17 U.S.C. 105)
nodes.rationale: Only NIST staff-authored or explicitly public-domain works kept; NASA handbook via NTRS PUBLIC_USE_PERMITTED; several NIST docs rejected.

nodes.label: OTel Collector Langfuse Overlay
nodes.rationale: Merged over config.yaml only when LANGFUSE_OTEL_ENDPOINT is set, so traces reach Langfuse from the collector, not from rag/.

nodes.label: slo:error_budget:remaining
nodes.rationale: Same group as the 30d rule so it reads this evaluation's value, not the previous one.

nodes.label: promtool SLO Window Tests
nodes.rationale: Step-pattern error rate so every window sees a different ratio; a rule over the wrong range or missing a term gives a wrong number.

nodes.label: Loki TraceID Derived Field
nodes.rationale: Links trace_id=<32 hex> in rag-api log lines to Tempo.

nodes.label: llama.cpp Prompt Cache Effect on TTFT
nodes.norm_label: llama.cpp prompt cache effect on ttft
nodes.rationale: Cached prompts skip prefill; cold numbers are what real users see, so the threshold is planned on cold traffic.

nodes.label: RAG Availability SLO (99%)
nodes.rationale: One replica, no failover; 99% allows about 7 h outage per 30d. SSE returns 200 before generation so in-stream errors are counted via rag_chat_errors_total; 4xx excluded.

nodes.label: RAG TTFT SLO (95% within 60 s)
nodes.rationale: 60 s held for every cold request measured (33 of 33); 30 s fails cold traffic. Ratio form is exact from buckets unlike histogram_quantile.

nodes.label: Grafana Alloy v1.20.1
nodes.rationale: Alloy, not Promtail: Promtail is deprecated in favour of Alloy.

nodes.label: Langfuse 4.56.0
nodes.rationale: v4 runs in events_only mode; read spans via /api/public/v2/observations.

nodes.label: Tempo 3.1.0
nodes.rationale: Tempo 3.x removed the ingester write path; config follows the 3.1.0 single-binary example.

nodes.label: Multi-Window Multi-Burn-Rate Alerting
nodes.rationale: Google SRE workbook ch. 5 approach 6; the short window lets the alert clear soon after the burn stops.

nodes.label: RagApiDown Blind-Spot Alert
nodes.rationale: The availability SLI only counts requests reaching the API, so a dead API looks healthy; up==0 for 2m pages.

nodes.label: gsm8k_pinned lm-eval task
nodes.rationale: Copy of lm-eval 0.4.13 gsm8k.yaml with the dataset revision pinned for reproducibility.

nodes.label: --generation-config vllm (repetition_penalty 1.1 default)
nodes.rationale: Without it vLLM applies the model's generation_config.json defaults, so absolute GSM8K scores are not stock.

nodes.label: PyTriton Python backend (not native TensorRT backend)
nodes.norm_label: pytriton python backend (not native tensorrt backend)

nodes.norm_label: t4 sw power cap / low sm clock confound

nodes.norm_label: vision map on coco val2017 subset

nodes.label: GSM8K accuracy comparison (AWQ vs FP16, TRT-LLM vs vLLM)
nodes.norm_label: gsm8k accuracy comparison (awq vs fp16, trt-llm vs vllm)

nodes.label: Result flag rules (CV, repeats, warmup, low SM clock)
nodes.norm_label: result flag rules (cv, repeats, warmup, low sm clock)
nodes.rationale: Flags noisy or suspicious results instead of smoothing them.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions ci.yml
nodes.rationale: Mirrors ci/Jenkinsfile but skips push, bump chart and argocd sync because a hosted runner cannot reach the developer's kind cluster, registry and git daemon.

nodes.label: Jenkins plugins.yaml
nodes.rationale: YAML rather than plugins.txt because gitleaks reads '<name>-api:<version>' lines as API keys; every dependency pinned so jenkins-plugin-cli resolves nothing.

nodes.label: Jenkins admin password secret file
nodes.rationale: Passed as a file, not env, so builds do not inherit it; still readable by builds on the controller (needs a separate agent to fix; not done).

nodes.label: Pipeline stages: lint, charts, test, build, scan, push, bump chart, argocd sync
nodes.norm_label: pipeline stages: lint, charts, test, build, scan, push, bump chart, argocd sync

nodes.label: Reproducible rag image digest (git archive, --provenance=false)
nodes.rationale: Same revision gives the same digest in kind-up and CI so nothing rolls unnecessarily; tag 0.1.0 is mutable.

nodes.label: Local judge: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct GGUF Q4_K_M on llama.cpp
nodes.norm_label: local judge: qwen2.5-7b-instruct gguf q4_k_m on llama.cpp
nodes.rationale: Free/local judge (compose profile eval, port 8081, temp 0, JSON-schema constrained). Much weaker than hosted judges DeepEval is tuned for; useful for comparing runs, not absolute quality.

nodes.label: NIST TN 2148 dropped from corpus
nodes.rationale: Licence could not be confirmed; questions 10-12 replaced.

nodes.label: questions.jsonl (30-question set)
nodes.rationale: Questions written from a single page per fact via pypdf text (same converter as ingest) so page numbers match stored page_number; factual lookups only, no multi-hop; single author, no second reviewer.

nodes.label: RAG eval run 20261008T095250Z (superseded)
nodes.rationale: 10-document corpus incl. NIST TN 2148; kept for the record. config.json git_commit 5cf3443 does not contain the rag code that ran (uncommitted tree).

nodes.label: Faithfulness (DeepEval)
nodes.rationale: Judge sees only the 5 retrieved chunks, so faithfulness says nothing about unretrieved chunks; recall@5 covers that.

nodes.label: Judge limitations
nodes.rationale: 7B Q4 judge, no human calibration, misreadings (q10, q7), small n=12, llama.cpp not fully deterministic at temperature 0.

nodes.label: Judge self-contradictions
nodes.rationale: Found by reading every reason; a keyword rule flagged 9 scores mostly wrongly and was dropped. Means reported with and without the 2 contradicted scores.

nodes.label: recall@5 (page level)
nodes.rationale: Page p or p-1 counts because a chunk is tagged with the page it starts on.

nodes.label: excluding_contradicted metrics (secondary view)
nodes.rationale: Drops only q11 answer_relevancy and q22 faithfulness; secondary view, not the headline.

nodes.label: llama.cpp prompt-cache hits skew latency
nodes.rationale: 27 of 30 prompts were cache hits so latency_s 7.999 (median 4.9 s, TTFT median 2.6 s) is not cold; cold TTFT 21.7 to 34.5 s.

nodes.label: apps list with sync waves
nodes.rationale: Infra deps first (wave 0), then the model server (wave 1), then the API that needs both (wave 2).

nodes.label: llamacpp kind arbitrary-UID emulation
nodes.rationale: Emulate an OpenShift-style arbitrary UID with group 0 on kind so SCC problems surface locally.

nodes.label: platform-deps Helm chart (dev-only Postgres, ES, Prometheus)
nodes.norm_label: platform-deps helm chart (dev-only postgres, es, prometheus)

nodes.label: platform-deps OpenShift values (empty, no Routes)
nodes.rationale: SCC assigns UID and fsGroup; nothing is exposed outside the cluster.

nodes.label: rag-api Helm chart (FastAPI + Haystack, Alembic hook, ingest Job)
nodes.norm_label: rag-api helm chart (fastapi + haystack, alembic hook, ingest job)

nodes.label: App-of-apps pattern
nodes.rationale: One ArgoCD Application per chart in deploy/helm, so a single root Application deploys the whole platform via GitOps.

nodes.label: SCC-safe defaults (no fixed UID, restricted securityContext)
nodes.norm_label: scc-safe defaults (no fixed uid, restricted securitycontext)
nodes.rationale: Base values carry no fixed UID so they pass OpenShift restricted-v2 SCC; per-platform values files add platform bits.

nodes.label: rag-ingest Job (Force=true,Replace=true, restartPolicy Never)
nodes.rationale: Job template is immutable so ArgoCD must replace it; restartPolicy Never keeps failed-attempt logs

nodes.label: rag-migrate Job (alembic upgrade head, Helm pre-install/pre-upgrade hook)
